thread:
morgan: FYI PR 22345 touches the hot path — KV cache eviction + batching heuristics. Want runtime + infra + security eyes before we merge. Risk: perf regression under bursty prefix loads.

sam: on it. I can take a perf pass today. any flame graphs / reproducer?

morgan: thanks. repro steps in the PR but quick snippet here:
```
# run load test
wrk -t8 -c200 --latency https://test-api.internal/v1/generate -d30s -s scripts/prefix-heavy.lua
```

alisa: I can look at infra changes (eviction TTL / sharding tweaks). pinging @nina for capacity/distribution concerns.

nina: noted. biggest question: will the new eviction policy increase CPU due to more frequent cache cleanup? if so we need autoscaler bump.

alan: I can review the runtime kernel changes tomorrow AM. is there a microbenchmark comparing old/new kv lookup cost?

morgan: not yet — sam is generating microbenchmarks. Alan, I'll add them to the PR once ready.

jyoti: quick security note: PR adds a call that touches customer KVs. confirm no plaintext logging and that KMS usage is limited to envelope keys. I can do a quick compliance check.

morgan: good catch. code has KMS wrapper but I want extra eyes. @jyoti please check logging surface and key usage.

ci-bot: All CI checks passed — unit, integration, and lint.

sam: microbenchmarks attached to PR: avg lookup ~+1.8% p50, +6% p99 under a synthetic prefix-heavy workload. seems acceptable but real traffic might differ.

alan: +1 on scope. those p99 numbers worry me for tail-sensitive endpoints. can we add a selective fallthrough to older behavior on canary?

morgan: plan: gate by feature flag, canary to 10% traffic, monitor tokens/sec and p99_latency; rollback if p99 increases >3%. deploy-bot: can you schedule a canary window tomorrow 10:00-12:00 PDT?

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2024-06-12 10:00 PDT -> 12:00 PDT. Notified oncall.

alisa: infra approvals: +1 pending autoscaler tune. I'll file a quick follow-up PR if needed.

jyoti: security done — no sensitive logging, KMS calls OK. left 2 small comments in PR about masking in error paths.

morgan: OK moving to ask for formal approvals. tagging reviewers: @alan (runtime), @nina (infra), @jyoti (security). Please add your approvals in PR when you're happy. If anyone needs more data ping me. :thumbsup:
